name: browser-use
headline: Codex Review: Code Review & Changelog Automation
short_description: Professional code review skill for Claude Code - Automatically collects change context and generates CHANGELOG with Codex AI integration
author: BenedictKing

sections.overview:
Codex Review is an automation skill that streamlines code review workflows by automatically collecting change context and generating detailed changelogs. It integrates with Codex AI to provide intelligent analysis of code modifications. The skill is designed for developers using Claude Code who need to maintain accurate change documentation and conduct systematic code reviews. It reduces manual effort in tracking changes and documenting project evolution.
Automatically generate changelogs from code changes
Collect and organize change context for review
Integrate AI-powered code analysis into review workflows
Maintain accurate project documentation during development
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/BenedictKing/codex-review`
sections.usage:
```
Perform a professional code review for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Analyze the following [DATA] and generate a detailed CHANGELOG entry. Include: 1) Summary of changes, 2) Impact analysis, 3) Potential risks, 4) Recommendations for improvement. Use Codex AI integration to ensure accuracy.
```
